page: Amazon Web Services trn2u.48xlarge is a dedicated accelerated computing instance in the AWS Trainium Gen2 family, built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The host environment provides 192 x86_64 vCPUs derived from 96 physical Intel cores running at 3.5 GHz with two threads per core. System memory is provisioned at 2048 GB, establishing a high memory allocation of approximately 10.67 GB per virtual core to accommodate large working sets during model processing.

Data-intensive staging and high-speed temporary caching are handled through 7600 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage. To support rapid inter-node synchronization across distributed computing clusters, the instance delivers a baseline network throughput of 3200 Gbps. This dense networking capability minimizes communication bottlenecks during collective operations in distributed architectures.

The balance of 192 compute threads, 2 TB of volatile memory, multi-terabyte NVMe storage, and high-bandwidth networking renders the trn2u.48xlarge suited for distributed deep learning model training, large language model fine-tuning, high-throughput machine learning pipelines, and intensive data processing tasks.
